label: Strictness separator: the box K node holds and the classical GOD_4 root fails on one model
paraphrase: Formal control on the one-point model of the necessary-sense fork (one world accessing itself, one concrete ungrounded candidate that exists there, is GOD_4 and has the signature's classical attributes field), with a q.3 a.4 profile in which the one being is in act and its represented esse and essence coincide: the box K node of the sense fork holds, while the classical GOD_4 root fails once the supplied intellect predicate is empty (the eighth of the nine case predicates). So the box K node does not entail the classical GOD_4 root. The failure comes only from that emptied predicate, a degenerate choice made for the control; the other supplied predicates are fixed as in the Lean control, and nothing is said about intellect. A statement about this formal interpretation only; nothing is claimed about the actual world or about which predicates apply to it.
